overview.description: The MicroSectors U.S. Big Oil - 3 Inverse Leveraged ETN (NRGD) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the Solactive MicroSectors U.S. Big Oil index. The fund aims to provide 300% inverse exposure to the daily price performance of an equal-weighted index of US Oil & Gas companies. Index components are selected by free-float market-cap. NRGD was launched on Feb 19, 2025 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
